question: An acompetitive (or uncompetitive) inhibitor of an enzyme:

options.opa: It does not bind to the enzyme until the enzyme-substrate complex has formed.
options.opb: It only binds to the free enzyme, not the enzyme-substrate complex.
options.opc: It binds to the enzyme in the active site.
options.opd: It can bind both the free enzyme and the enzyme-substrate complex.
